title: Spike: one Chatticus turn driven by the Pi SDK with sessions in DynamoDB
description:
Throwaway spike (spikes/pi-harness-<id>/) answering, with measurements:
1. Can @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent's SDK run headless in a Node 22 Lambda (bundle size, cold start, ~/.pi avoidance via SessionManager.inMemory + SettingsManager.inMemory + explicit model runtime)?
2. Round-trip: load a bot-per-channel session from stored entries, run one prompt on OpenAI gpt-5-nano, capture the new entries (message_end/entry_appended or getEntries diff) and write them back; reload and continue.
3. Map Pi events onto the one-turn stream: which events, delta vs snapshot, size per turn.
4. Inject another participant's message as a custom_message and confirm the model sees the attribution.
5. Gate a tool via pi.on('tool_call') (block with a reason) and point bash at a remote executor via BashOperations.
Results go into a design note (docs/PI_HARNESS.md) before any product code.
right_now_summary: The team is testing a Pi SDK Lambda harness with DynamoDB sessions, event streaming, message attribution, and tool
